title: NEETS 01 - Matter, Energy, and Direct Current
safety_note: Training reference; isolate power and verify absence of voltage before touching conductors.

title: NEETS 02 - Alternating Current and Transformers
safety_note: Training reference; mains and stored energy can kill.

title: NEETS 03 - Circuit Protection, Control, and Measurement
safety_note: Use correctly rated protection and test equipment.

title: NEETS 04 - Conductors, Wiring, and Schematic Reading
safety_note: De-energize, lock out, verify, and follow current wiring codes.

title: NEETS 05 - Generators and Motors
safety_note: Rotating machinery and generated voltage require guards and isolation.

title: NEETS 06 - Electronic Emission, Tubes, and Power Supplies
safety_note: High-voltage power supplies and charged capacitors can remain lethal after shutdown.

title: NEETS 07 - Solid-State Devices and Power Supplies
safety_note: Observe ESD, polarity, thermal, and stored-energy precautions.

title: NEETS 08 - Amplifiers
safety_note: Verify supply rails and discharge capacitors before service.

title: NEETS 09 - Wave Generation and Wave Shaping
safety_note: Use rated probes and observe instrument ground limits.

title: NEETS 10 - Propagation, Transmission Lines, and Antennas
safety_note: RF exposure, lightning, and tower work require current controls and trained personnel.

title: NEETS 11 - Microwave Principles
safety_note: Do not defeat RF interlocks; high voltage and microwave exposure can injure or kill.

title: NEETS 12 - Modulation Principles
safety_note: Theory reference; transmit only where licensed and lawful.

title: NEETS 13 - Number Systems and Logic Circuits
safety_note: Verify voltage families and ESD controls before connecting logic devices.

title: NEETS 14 - Microelectronics
safety_note: Use ventilation and appropriate controls for solder, flux, solvents, and ESD.

title: NEETS 15 - Synchros, Servos, and Gyros
safety_note: Unexpected motion and energized control circuits require isolation.

title: NEETS 16 - Test Equipment
safety_note: Use instruments and leads rated for the circuit category and voltage.

title: NEETS 17 - Radio-Frequency Communications Principles
safety_note: Observe RF exposure, interference, spectrum, and licensing rules.

title: NEETS 18 - Radar Principles
safety_note: Radar equipment combines lethal voltage, RF exposure, and mechanical hazards.

title: NEETS 19 - Technician's Handbook
safety_note: Reference only; use current component and equipment specifications.

title: NEETS 20 - Master Glossary
safety_note: Terminology reference; not a substitute for equipment-specific procedures.

title: NEETS 21 - Test Methods and Practices
safety_note: Live diagnosis is hazardous; use isolation and appropriately rated equipment.

title: NEETS 22 - Digital Computers
safety_note: Historical architecture reference; verify modern interfaces and supply limits.

title: NEETS 23 - Magnetic Recording
safety_note: Historical equipment reference; rotating and high-voltage hazards may be present.

title: NEETS 24 - Fiber Optics
safety_note: Never view an energized fiber; control glass shards and laser exposure.

title: Automotive Mechanic Course Outline and Shop Practice
publisher: ERIC / U.S. Department of Education archive
safety_note: Older curriculum; use current manufacturer procedures, specifications, and safety rules.

title: NIOSH - Occupational Safety and Health in Vocational Education
safety_note: Begin with shop safety; never work beneath a vehicle supported only by a jack.

title: TM 9-8000 - Principles of Automotive Vehicles
safety_note: General theory is dated; model-specific torque values, fluids, lifting points, and procedures control.

title: Army Wheeled Vehicle Electrical Systems
publisher: U.S. Army curriculum archived by ERIC
safety_note: Older vehicle technology; isolate batteries and verify current model-specific procedures.

title: NAVEDTRA 14081 - Equipment Operator, Basic
safety_note: Heavy equipment requires trained operators, inspections, exclusion zones, and machine-specific manuals.

title: OSHA - Light Truck and Automobile Tire Service Hazards
publisher: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
safety_note: Tire and rim assemblies can fail explosively; use trained procedures and restraining equipment.

title: OSHA - Asbestos in Automotive Brake and Clutch Work
publisher: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
safety_note: Older and replacement friction materials may contain asbestos; do not create airborne dust.

title: NAVEDTRA 12964 - Fluid Power: Hydraulics and Pneumatics
safety_note: Stored hydraulic or pneumatic energy and injection injuries can kill; depressurize and verify zero energy.

title: NAVEDTRA 14080 - Equipment Operator, Advanced
safety_note: Advanced reference for trained operators; machine-specific load charts and manuals control.

title: NAVEDTRA 14050 - Construction Mechanic, Advanced
safety_note: Advanced reference; do not improvise safety-critical repairs or exceed manufacturer limits.

title: OSHA - Using Aerial Lifts and Bucket Trucks
publisher: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration
safety_note: Bucket and aerial lifts require training, fall protection, clearance, inspection, and manufacturer instructions.
